rigid_screen.scope: Selected rigid interfaces, sampled at the times listed in counts. Includes prior motion/support scenarios and new hardware versus surrounding parts and header clamps versus process heads, rotor and guards. R20 main drive versus existing rigid geometry and rotor versus new fixed parts use 0.02 s; prior new hardware scenarios use 0.05 s. New CAD subassembly internal fits are screened separately by exact B-rep rest-pose checks and 2D tooth sweeps. Exact same-joint fastener meshes and designated plate/lug mates are excluded from collision screening; actual target bores and stack faces are checked separately in check-hardware20. Existing explicit bearing/nut/follower mates are excluded. Broad phase skips AABB overlap below 0.2 mm. Flexible leaves, film, hoses, continuous sweep, tolerances and remaining full-machine interfaces are not validated.

summary: R20新增234个主传动CAD实体实例与51套紧固件；保留18处接头、40套穿栓、40根空心型材及13组安装细节。基础17 组机构支承/动力/传动记录，10416/10663 条结构零件已关联记录；推杆退让与高位回程、分度前拨叉退出及局部网格检查通过。记录关联不等于紧固、载荷或整机无干涉验收。四列包装对接仍待重构。
